editor.help.banana-b: Edits photos according to description and uses additional pictures. It's a more cost-effective option than the Nano Banana Pro for most common edits. After processing, compare important inscriptions and faces with the original. Resolution, web search and number of results affect the price.
editor.help.banana-pro-q: Complex instructions, compositions and work with several additional pictures. More expensive than regular Nano Banana. For important text and faces, compare the result with the source. Resolution upgrades and web searches cost extra.
editor.help.object-e: Quickly remove an object inside a mask. Use the brush to select everything that needs to be removed, including the shadow. Text instructions are not sent. Economy mode may be less able to restore complex backgrounds.
editor.help.object-b: Removing an object using a mask with more thorough restoration of the background. Instructions are not used; the action is determined by the mask. For large objects and repeating patterns, the result should be compared with the original.
editor.help.object-q: Removes an object by mask in the best quality mode of the Object Removal family. Paint over the entire object, including any unnecessary shadow; text instructions are not sent. Even this mode cannot reliably restore details hidden by the object being removed.
editor.help.eraser-b: Removing an object from the white area of the mask and filling it with the surrounding background. Works with one source, without additional pictures and text instructions. For careful removal, grab the edges of the object and its shadow.
editor.help.fill-q: Fills the mask area according to instructions: for example, you can describe the background that should appear instead of a removed object. Does not accept additional pictures. The price depends on the number of pixels in the result.
editor.help.pixelcut-b: Automatically separates the main subject and removes the background. The original image is enough: a mask, text and additional images are not needed. After treatment, check hair, fur, thin edges and translucent areas.
editor.help.ideogram-bg-b: Automatically removes background from one image; the main object selects the service. Text and additional images are not used. The model is designed to produce transparent results; Check the background and edges of the object before saving.
editor.help.bria-bg-q: Separates the object and makes the background transparent. The mask and additional pictures are not used. If desired, specify in text which object to leave: for example, only the chair. The text instructions change the rate, so check the estimate before you start.
editor.help.outpaint-e: Quickly continues the scene beyond the edges of the photograph. Set the size of the new fields in pixels. Text and additional images are not used. If the response matches the requested canvas, the program saves the original pixels; for other sizes, shows the model's response with a warning.
editor.help.outpaint-q: A more thorough mode of continuing the scene beyond the edges. Accepts one source and the sizes of new fields, without text instructions and additional pictures. The price depends on the size of the source and the result. Accurate preservation of the original pixels is possible if the size of the response matches the requested canvas; otherwise the response is shown with a warning.
editor.help.expand-b: Expands the canvas according to the specified dimensions and position of the source. If desired, add instructions in English. The original photograph must occupy at least 15% of the area of ​​the new canvas. Additional pictures are not used.
editor.help.ideo-replace-e: Changes the background in fast TURBO mode. Describe a new scene, such as a sunny garden. The service itself determines the main object. The request includes only the original photo; additional images remain in the project, but are not sent. Check the complex edges of the object on the result.
editor.help.ideo-replace-b: Changes the background in BALANCED mode, which combines speed and quality. Describe the environment that should appear behind the object. Only the original photo is included in the request. After processing, check whether the desired object and its shadows are preserved.
editor.help.ideo-replace-q: Changes the background in QUALITY mode - the most expensive in this family. Describe your desired environment. The service itself determines the main object; The request includes only the original photo, without additional images. Compare the result with the original, especially the edges of the main object.
editor.help.crisp-e: Inexpensively enlarges a photo and enhances clarity. Text, markup and additional images are not sent. Suitable for fast processing; severe smearing and poorly distinguishable small letters may not be corrected.
editor.help.seedvr-e: Enlarges one image by a factor or to the selected resolution. Text and additional images are not used. The price depends on the number of megapixels of the source and the result; the model can fill in small details.
editor.help.clarity-b: Enlargement with controlled drawing of details. The instructions can clarify the content of the scene; similarity and creative freedom are specified separately. With high freedom, faces and inscriptions can change.
editor.help.precision-b: Enlarges the image using the Topaz Standard V2 algorithm, trying to preserve the structure of the source. Works with one photo; Facial restoration is enabled separately. The size of the finished image affects the cost, so check the estimate before you go.
editor.help.precision-q: Enlargement of Topaz High Fidelity V3 with an emphasis on preserving the original parts. Does not accept additional pictures or text instructions. For documents and faces, be sure to compare the finer details of the result.
editor.help.dust-q: Topaz Dust-Scratch V2 removes dust and scratches from a single image. Markup and text do not control processing. Preservation of the original color is configured separately. Compare the result with the original to check whether the useful texture has disappeared along with the defects.
editor.help.flash-e: Performs inexpensive edits based on descriptions with several additional pictures. The service can downsample input images to one million pixels, so check the output for small lettering and faces. The allowed number of images and the size of the result are specified in the model parameters.
editor.help.klein-e: Fast version for simple changes and a small number of additional images. Complex faces, inscriptions and small details need to be compared with the original.
editor.help.grok-e: Edits a photo according to a text task and accepts up to two additional images. In automatic mode, the aspect ratio is selected based on the first image. Describe how to use each attached picture.
editor.help.seed-lite-b: Edits photographs and composes compositions with several additional pictures. The result size is more than one million pixels; For a very small copy after generation, normal resizing can be used.
editor.help.flare-b: Editing according to detailed instructions with several additional pictures. The initial quality mode is medium; it can be changed in the available options. The cost depends on the volume of text and images.
editor.help.sunburst-q: Edits a photograph according to detailed instructions; The default is High quality. The price depends on the size, text and number of images. If local editing is needed, check the support of the selected markup. Compare important details with the source before saving.
editor.help.seed-pro-q: Edits photographs and composes compositions with several additional pictures. The image limit shown includes the source. The size of the result and the number of investments affect the estimate of the launch cost.
editor.help.rembg-e: Automatic background removal without text instructions. Check thin edges and translucent objects.
editor.help.birefnet-q: Removing the background while maintaining thin edges and transparency. Payment depends on calculation time; The amount before launch is approximate. Check hair, fur and translucent areas.
editor.help.wonder-q: Enlargement with additional drawing Wonder 3.5. Faces, inscriptions and small details must be compared with the original.
editor.help.creative-q: Enlarges the image while adding new details. Suitable for creative enhancement, but may change letters, facial features and texture. If the accuracy of the document or original features is important, compare the result with the original.
editor.help.iclight-q: Changes the lighting of the photo. Use a mask to designate the object for which you want to adjust the light, and describe the desired lighting in the instructions. In this operation, the mask represents the object to be illuminated, rather than the area to be removed.
editor.help.nafnet-e: Reduces photo blur. This mode is designed for lubrication; To correct scratches, color and other damage to an old photo, choose a suitable restoration model.
editor.help.photo-restore-b: Corrects scratches on an old photo. For this model, the program accepts pictures with aspect ratios of 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3 or 3:4. If the source is of a different shape, it is not cropped automatically: first prepare a suitable frame or select a different model.
